repo.description:
### Impact
A user could create a docx or odt file with a `#` in the filename with confidential information such as a credit card number and have it not be marked as confidential.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud files_confidential app is upgraded to 3.3.1, 4.1.1 or 5.1.0

### Workarounds

* Change config setting: Add `#` to `forbidden_filename_characters` and rename all affected files

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3682163)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/files_confidential/pull/262)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Files Confidential tagging can be bypassed with # in filename
